messages:
sales_jordan: FYI AcmeCorp POC failing intermittently during embeddings job. Saw spikes of 502s and some latency >5s. They run bulk shipper every 30s. Can we swarm? :rotating_light:
maya_se: On it. Which model/endpoint? any pattern in payload size?
alex_m: They use /v1/embeddings with our text-embedding-3-large, batching ~2k docs per request (avg 600 tokens). Getting gateway 502 then retry.
sre_oncall: Can you paste the last few logs? also need request ids.
sales_jordan: Copied the last 3 errors from their client: ```
2024-05-12T15:02:11Z ERROR req=aa12 gateway 502 upstream reset
2024-05-12T15:02:41Z ERROR req=aa15 timeout waiting for model backend
2024-05-12T15:03:11Z ERROR req=aa18 502 downstream closed
```
alex_m: Thanks. Looks like upstream model worker OOM or overloaded. But question: they also mentioned data residency / VPC egress requirements — they may be routing through a proxy that adds TLS handshake delays.
maya_se: I pushed a reduced batch size suggestion to them (500 docs/request) while we investigate.
sre_oncall: I'm seeing a pattern on our side: bursts map to a single worker hitting >95% GPU memory and then the router returns 502s. We have auto-fallback to quantized variant but fallback not triggered because model version pins are set on the POC.
security_ops: Also a heads-up — AcmeCorp's SSQ flagged that we need to confirm KMS/HSM support and whether logs contain PII. May slow any Private deploy.
sales_jordan: They asked about pricing for dedicated capacity if we recommend lowering batch sizes => cost impact. Need a quick ballpark.
alex_m: For dedicated, rough estimate: moving from hosted to reserved GPUs reduces token-unit cost by ~40% at steady throughput; but short-term spike mitigation (burst) has extra charge. I'll get a calc.
sre_oncall: For immediate triage: 1) reduce client batch size (done) 2) remove strict model pin to allow fallback to quantized variant OR increase worker pool; which do we prefer?
maya_se: Can we do a quick canary to toggle model pin for this customer only? Want to avoid global change.
sre_oncall: Yes we can route their requests to a compat variant via routing policy — takes ~10-15m if we update their customer routing tag. Need product approval?
alex_m: I can approve temporary routing change for POC.
deploy-bot: deploy request 44431 queued by alex_m. CI checks passed. ETA ~12m.
security_ops: While we patch, please capture minimal logs and redact PII. We need evidence for the SSQ: confirm KMS support (yes we support AWS KMS + customer-managed keys) and that logs can be configured to exclude payloads.
sales_jordan: Acme is also worried about SLA if we change model during POC. Can we note rollback plan?
maya_se: Rollback is immediate: route back to pinned model and scale up workers; both reversible.
sre_oncall: Action items: 1) deploy routing change (alex_m) 2) monitor worker memory & GPU usage (me) 3) send SSQ KMS answer + log policy to Acme (security_ops) 4) send pricing delta for Dedicated + burst buffer (alex_m).
sales_jordan: Timeline? Customer needs update in 30m.
alex_m: I’ll draft pricing calc and send in 20m.
security_ops: I’ll prepare SSQ snippet in 25m and share redaction config.
sre_oncall: Routing change in progress — deploying now. Will post monitor link.
deploy-bot: deploy 44431 started by alex_m. logs: https://ci.internal/reports/44431
sre_oncall: Monitoring dashboard: https://dash.internal/team/poctriage?cust=acme 
alex_m: Pricing note: moving to Dedicated (4x A10G equiv) estimated $XX/hr sustained; add burst buffer ~+15% for peak protection. Will put precise numbers in doc.
sales_jordan: Perfect. Once routing is live, ask them to rerun the failing job and paste the new request ids.
maya_se: Will coordinate with their SRE.
sre_oncall: Update: routing change completed. Started draining pinned workers for Acme. No errors yet in last 2 mins.
sales_jordan: :tada: Great. Sending interim update now. Will follow up with final pricing + SSQ docs.
security_ops: Sharing SSQ snippet: "We support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS and HSM integrations. Logs can be configured to strip or not collect request payloads; audit trails preserved via metadata only." (draft)
maya_se: Customer confirmed they reran sample — sent new req ids: bb21, bb22, bb23 no 502s.
sre_oncall: Good. Continued observation for 1h. If stable, we recommend updating POC config to allow fallback variant or provision dedicated pool.
sales_jordan: Thanks team. I'll keep Acme posted and move to contract discussion on dedicated pricing if needed. :handshake:
